主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announced a share repurchase program, intending to repurchase up to 20 million of its common shares. This action reflects the bank's strategy to enhance shareholder value by reducing the number of outstanding shares. The repurchase is part of the bank's ongoing capital management initiatives, aimed at optimizing its capital structure and improving earnings per share. The announcement was made on February 27, 2019, as part of the bank's regulatory filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The move is expected to have a positive impact on the bank's stock price and shareholder returns, though the exact timing and execution details of the repurchase program were not disclosed in the filing. The decision to repurchase shares is based on the bank's assessment of its financial position and market conditions, indicating confidence in its long-term prospects and ability to generate returns for shareholders.
